name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
"Your fortune awaits you inside Wailing Caverns."

The fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of a cave to the southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens.  Focusing closer in on the image, you wind about twisty passages until you reach a shimmering portal... one that leads into the heart of the caverns itself.  Stepping through it, a strange chest appears out from nowhere.
narrative.objectives: Travel to the Wailing Caverns in the Barrens and seek out your fortune.
narrative.offerRewardText: A quick search of the chest reveals a lockbox from within it!  It would seem that you have found your fortune!
narrative.requestItemsText: This chest looks like the one from your vision...
